content.title:
Snackolator on Instagram: "Are you grabbing the new McDonald's x K-Pop Demon Hunters Huntr/x Meal? I love the McShaker Fries, new McNugget sauces, and the Derpy McFlurry!

#mcdonalds #fastfood #fastfoodreview #eating #kpopdemonhunters"
content.text: I was waiting for the dang toy like BTS. This was some BSI'll say one thing- collectible cards are HOT AF right now so that's 💯 ON POINT!! Plus KPOP too?! Yeahhh they definitely knew what they were doingLook. McDonald's gotta keep paying me my dividends, they gotta cut some corners here and there. Ya'll will be ok. Ty in advanceMy dude is holding a $50 card on Mercari 😭 and it’s worth nothing to himI’m not eating anything purpleThe McFlurry definitely hit, but the fries were an experience for me. First, they tried to give me the seasoning powder without any fries. Then they kept asking me if I wanted the fries to be a small, when they are supposed to be a medium for proportion to the seasoning. Then they finally gave me the fries - but with no shaker bag, so I just had to dump the seasoning on top. I guess that's what I get for ordering from McDonald's on April Fools' Day.... maybe I'll have to try again if the meal is available long enough.The adults saying they prefer a card to a toy... Like ... Yeah. That's a good thing bc you're not a child. McDonald's COULD have done something for the kids too (especially bc you can't find DH toys/merch anywhere, so it definitely would have brought more parents in) but sure let's appease the Kidults first. Prob the same childless ppl who go to Disney 5x a yearWhy do Australia not get all thisI typically do not eat fast food, but I had to try the Huntrix meal. I loved the film and the soundtrack and also love Kpop. As far as the meal goes, the sauces were decent. I would say the purple demon sauce tastes like mayo mixed with a tiny bit of horseradish. The other sauce is definitely a sweet chili sauce. I personally wasn't a fan of the fries with the seasoning, as I just found it too salty. The Derpy McFlurry was very good and not too sweet. The popping boba taste was a delicious berry flavor. The packaging was great and the cards were very cool and colorful. They have almost a holographic design.I mean they do call it “adult” happy meals, and K-pop photocards does make sense for a K-pop inspired meal
